newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Finl calls suit without merit.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Finl calls suit without merit.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd on Monday described a suit filed against it in New York by certain shareholders challenging the company's reporting and disclosure standards as without merit.

The company said the action filed in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York was similar to one previously filed in the District of Minnesota on March 4. Olympic expects the two cases to be consolidated and disposed of together.
"Consistent with past statements, the company's policy has always been, and will continue to be, complete and accurate disclosure," said president Richard Greenwalt in a statement.
Olympic is a consumer finance company that purchases, sells and services retail installment contracts for new and used cars originated originated by more than 7,700 dealers nationwide.
